visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Reverse In Place with Two Indices
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This code copies the array into a second one, then copies it back. Reverse it in place with a left and a right index instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Two indices walking towards each other swap the elements in place, so no second array and no copy-back loop are needed. This is the two-pointer technique used in many interview problems.
